Package domain

Class TournamentMode

java.lang.Object
domain.GameMode
domain.TournamentMode
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class TournamentMode extends GameMode
Tournament of 8 teams against the machine: quarterfinals, semifinal and final. The player plays its match on screen; the other matches of each round are simulated. The player is always on the left of its BracketMatch, like in the Match on screen.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda

  • Constructor Details

    • TournamentMode

      public TournamentMode(GameCharacter leftCharacter, Stats leftStats, PlayerController leftController, Stats rightStats, PlayerController rightController, MatchType type, String resolution, BallSkin skin, List<GameCharacter> others, Random random) throws DOPOSoccerException
      Creates the tournament. The bracket is drawn in start().
      Parameters:
      leftCharacter - character of the player
      leftStats - stats of the player
      leftController - who controls the player
      rightStats - stats of the rivals
      rightController - who controls the rivals
      type - rule of each match
      resolution - "SMALL", "MEDIUM" or "LARGE"
      skin - ball chosen to play
      others - the teams that can be rivals (at least 7)
      random - draws the bracket, the stadium of each match and the matches between the other teams
      Throws:
      DOPOSoccerException - INVALID_STATE if there are less than 7 rivals

    • start

      public void start() throws DOPOSoccerException
      Draws the quarterfinals: 7 random rivals, the player against the first one and the other 6 in pairs. Then creates the match of the player.

      Throws:
      DOPOSoccerException - UNKNOWN_RESOLUTION if the resolution is not valid
